chatDescription: Hello! I'm here to help you explore the festivals of Cusco. Find answers to common questions below.
chatFaqPopularQ1: What is the biggest festival in Cusco?
chatFaqPopularA1: Inti Raymi, the Festival of the Sun, is the largest and most famous theatrical reenactment of an ancient Inca ceremony.
chatFaqPopularQ2: Which month has the most festivals?
chatFaqPopularA2: June is a particularly busy month for festivals in Cusco, including the famous Inti Raymi and Corpus Christi.
chatFaqQuizQ1: I don't know where to start! Can you help?
chatFaqQuizA1: Of course! Our Festival Finder quiz will ask you a few questions to give you personalized recommendations based on your interests.
chatFaqQuizQ2: I'm looking for a deep spiritual experience.
chatFaqQuizA2: We recommend Qoyllur Rit'i or the pilgrimage to the Lord of Huanca, both are powerful experiences of faith and devotion.
chatFaqPlanningQ1: Can I see all the festivals on a map?
chatFaqPlanningA1: Yes, on our Map page you can see the location of all the festivals to better plan your route.
chatFaqPlanningQ2: How can I find out the exact dates?
chatFaqPlanningA2: Our interactive Calendar allows you to explore festivals by date and see what's happening each day.
